stabilityRanking.currentVsAverageMetric: Positive-profit crafts only. Trader-sale outputs are treated as 0% sale-price deviation. Flea-sale outputs use absolute deviation between current lastLowPrice and avg24hPrice. Stable <=10%; very-stable <=5%.
stabilityRanking.historicalMetric: Trailing 24h sale-price coefficient of variation from recent main-branch GitHub report snapshots. Trader sale = 0% CV. Flea ranking requires at least 6 snapshots. Stable CV <=10%; very-stable CV <=5%. Ranking is current profitPerHour descending after stability filter.
